subject: Evaluation handoff and compliance checkpoints — RotorBank MAP
messages:
From: Suzanne Miller <suzanne.miller@rotorbank.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@rotorbank.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial MAP request + SOC2/DPA questions

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — RotorBank is excited to explore Redwood for our customer-facing assistant use case. Our procurement and security teams asked me to capture the compliance items they need to see in the mutual action plan so we can schedule an internal decision by end of Q3. Can you confirm the rough timing and owners for the following in your MAP?

- SOC 2 attestation: do you have a recent report and how long to provide evidence for our assessment?
- SIG/CAIQ: can we get a completed CAIQ, and are there gaps we should expect?
- DPA redline cycle: typical turnaround for review + signature?
- Data residency & retention: can you provide a table of what data is retained, retention windows, and where backups reside? We need EU residency options for a portion of our workload.

Attached is the RFP section relevant to security (RB_RFP_Q2_2027.pdf).

Can your team share a draft MAP with milestones and owners this week? Also if we could lock in a 60-minute workshop to align on evidence intake, that would help speed things up.

Thanks,
Suzanne Miller
Head of Vendor Risk — RotorBank
[sent on behalf of Procurement and Security]

Attachment: RB_RFP_Q2_2027.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Suzanne Miller <suzanne.miller@rotorbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:44:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + SOC2/DPA questions

Hi Suzanne — great to connect. Appreciate the RFP extract, and I’ve attached a first-pass MAP we can iterate on (MAP_draft_RotorBank_v1.pdf). High level responses to your asks below, plus proposed milestones.

Summary responses:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a Type II SOC 2 report for the period ending 2026-12-31. We can provide the report under NDA and a scoped evidence package (controls owners, policy docs). Evidence intake typically takes 2–3 weeks from kickoff depending on depth.
- SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a completed CAIQ; we’ll share a gap summary. The CAIQ + SOC2 will cover the large majority of your controls.
- DPA: We can provide our standard DPA draft immediately. Typical redline cycle is ~1–2 weeks for minor changes; for complex regulatory carveouts we budget 3–4 weeks.
- Data residency & retention: Draft table included in the MAP. Options: (a) hosted EU region (data-at-rest and primary backups in EU), (b) hybrid routing for EU-only traffic. Retention defaults: logs 90 days, call transcripts 30 days (configurable), retained backups 180 days (longer by contract).

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + evidence workshop (owner: Maya)
2) Week 1–2: SOC2 evidence collection (owner: Neha)
3) Week 1–3: CAIQ + gap summary (owner: Priyom)
4) Week 2–4: DPA redline & legal review (owner: Lauren)
5) Week 4–6: Pilot sign-off + data-handling confirmation (owners: Customer Prod + Redwood Security)

We’ll plan the workshop for Wednesday 16 Jun 10:00–11:00 PT unless that time doesn’t work for you.

Next asks for you: please confirm who from RotorBank will attend the evidence workshop (security SME, legal, procurement) and whether the EU residency requirement is a must-have for the initial pilot or can be staged for the production rollout.

I’ve attached: MAP_draft_RotorBank_v1.pdf and a short SOC2-Overview.pdf.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

Attachments: MAP_draft_RotorBank_v1.pdf (application/pdf), SOC2-Overview.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:02:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Initial MAP request + SOC2/DPA questions — internal owners and timing

Team — forwarding RotorBank thread. High level asks above. Quick notes / asks for owners:

- Neha: you’ll lead SOC2 evidence intake and can coordinate the evidence template. Aim to have the initial evidence bundle ready within 10 business days of the workshop. Please flag any controls that require engineering involvement (network diagrams, IAM logs).
- Priyom: please run CAIQ completion and prepare a concise gap summary (2–3 pages) we can share in the MAP.
- Lauren: please take point on DPA redlines; forecast needed to turn around up to 3 weeks if legal requests carveouts. We may need pricing credit if RotorBank requests extended retention >180 days.

A few clarifying points for the workshop:
- We will present the signed SOC2 report (redacted where needed), the CAIQ, and the retention table.
- EU residency: confirm whether they require all backups to reside in the EU for pilot — that’s a larger ops change and may require dedicated routing. If they require it for pilot, indicate here so we can flag for infra team.

I’ll draft the workshop agenda and send invites once Suzanne confirms attendees.

From: Suzanne Miller <suzanne.miller@rotorbank.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@rotorbank.com, legal@rotorbank.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 15:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial MAP request + SOC2/DPA questions

Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft MAP. The workshop on 16 Jun was useful; we had our security SME, procurement and legal on the call. A few follow-ups and confirmations:

- RotorBank confirms the pilot can run with EU residency staged for production (great to know it’s an option). For pilot we only need EU residency for cardholder-facing traffic, not the entire workload.
- SOC2: we appreciate the report and the evidence bundle. Neha, can you highlight where logging and MFA controls are documented so our cloud security lead can validate?
- CAIQ: fine, please share the gap summary you mentioned.
- DPA: our legal team has one modest carveout request around backups stored with third-party cold storage — they want explicit language that backups with third-party vendors will not be used for analytics and will be encrypted at rest with KMS we jointly verify. Can you prepare a short redline and route to DocuSign when ready?
- Retention table: please provide an explicit table with each artifact (audit logs, transcripts, model inputs, model outputs, backups) and default retention + configurable max retention. Our compliance lead wants it in spreadsheet form.

We’ve attached a simple scope matrix for your reference (RotorBank_ScopeMatrix.xlsx). Once you share the updated MAP + DPA redline, please include a DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks — Suzanne

Attachment: RotorBank_ScopeMatrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
